question: Who was appointed as the Director General of Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) in September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrit Mohan Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Amrit Mohan Prasad was appointed as the Director General of Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) in September 2024.
 
• He has a vast experience in law enforcement and has served in various capacities in the police force.
 
• His appointment to the SSB is expected to strengthen the security and operational efficiency of the organization.
 
• Amrit Mohan Prasad is known for his strategic and leadership skills, which will be beneficial in managing the Indo-Nepal and Indo-Bhutan borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)**

 
 
• SSB is one of the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) of India under the administrative control of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).
 
• It was established in 1963 to ensure the security of India's borders with Nepal and Bhutan.
 
• The primary role of SSB is to prevent trans-border crimes, smuggling, and any other illegal activities.
 
• SSB is also involved in various internal security duties, disaster management, and providing assistance to the local police in maintaining law and order.
 
 
 
• **Director General (DG)**
 
 
• The Director General is the highest-ranking officer of the Sashastra Seema Bal and is responsible for the overall command, control, and administration of the force.
 
• The DG ensures the implementation of policies, the welfare of personnel, and efficient functioning of the organization.
 
• The DG is typically an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer of the rank of Director General of Police (DGP).
 
 
 
• **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF)**
 
 
• CAPFs are a group of seven security forces in India, which include the Border Security Force (BSF), Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), Central Industrial Security Force (CISF), Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP), Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB), National Security Guard (NSG), and Assam Rifles (AR).
 
• These forces are responsible for maintaining internal security, border security, and counter-insurgency operations.
 
• They operate under the Ministry of Home Affairs and play a crucial role in safeguarding the nation from various threats.
